title: Refurbished Gaming Laptops on eBay: What to Know Before You Buy
description: Refurbished RTX gaming laptops on eBay, what the Certified, Excellent, Very Good and Good grades mean, and how to check a listing before you buy.
h1: Refurbished Gaming Laptops on eBay: What to Know Before You Buy
intro: A refurbished gaming laptop can cost noticeably less than a new one, and eBay's refurbished program adds warranty and return protection that ordinary used listings don't have. Below are the cheapest refurbished listings in our catalogue for three RTX laptop tiers, followed by how the condition grades work.

sections.h2: What the eBay refurbished grades mean
paragraphs: According to eBay's refurbished program pages, items sold under the program are tested and fully functional. Certified Refurbished items come in like-new condition from the brand or an authorized seller and carry a two-year warranty. Excellent, Very Good and Good items come from vetted sellers, differ in how much cosmetic wear they show, and carry a one-year warranty.

Seller Refurbished is different. It is a condition an individual seller chooses, it is not part of the official program, and the program's warranty terms are not stated to apply to it. Read that listing carefully.

eBay also describes a 30-day return window for program items and covers purchases with its Money Back Guarantee. The warranty has exclusions, including purchases made outside the US and accidental or cosmetic damage. Terms can change, so confirm them on the listing and on eBay's program pages before you buy.
